name: Telnyx
tagline: Walks you through a Telnyx setup, from empty account to first live test
description: It takes someone who has never touched the platform and gets them to a working integration: opening the account, generating credentials, taking on a number, wiring up messaging or calls, pointing webhooks somewhere real, and proving the whole chain end to end before you build on it.
author: traviscurnutte
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
